anchors.paper_title: Imaging the effective networks associated with cortical function through intracranial high‐frequency stimulation
anchors.reason: Barborica 2021 HBM paper introduces the alternating-polarity stimulation paradigm and analysis method the dataset uses; it has 26 patients, not this dataset's 22 with visual effects.

metadata.methods_description: High-frequency bipolar intracranial stimulations were delivered using alternating polarity biphasic pulses of 1 ms duration at 43.2 Hz or 50 Hz, with current intensities between 0.25 and 3 mA, for up to 5 seconds. The alternating polarity protocol was used to disambiguate neuronal responses time-locked to stimulation from artefactual components. Recordings span 8 seconds before stimulation onset, the stimulation period (up to 5 s), and 8 seconds after stimulation offset. Stimulation contact pairs, current intensity, and evoked clinical effects were documented in accompanying events files.
